---
name: "🧩 New Widget Suggestion"
about: Suggest a new widget type for developers to build (e.g. RSS Feed, Spotify, Calendar).
title: "[WIDGET] "
labels: new-widget, good first issue
assignees: ""
---

**Proposed Widget Name**
A clear and short name for the proposed widget (e.g., "GitHub Contribution Graph Widget").

**Widget Description**
Describe what the widget does and what it will render.

**Customization Options (Config)**
What options should the user be able to customize in the Editor? E.g.:

- [ ] Text Color
- [ ] Background Color/Gradient
- [ ] Custom API Keys / Feeds
- [ ] Layout Size (Small, Medium, Large)

**Visual Design Ideas / Wireframe**
Provide any design suggestions, layout references, or links to similar widgets you've seen.
